pharmacology.text: Propylhexedrine works mainly as an adrenergic agonist, when used at therapeutic doses in an inhaler dosage form. This restricts the blood vessels in the nose and reduces swelling; thereby, it relieves nasal congestion. At higher doses, propylhexedrine affects the central nervous system as a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA).

uses.text: Propylhexedrine is used to treat acute nasal congestion related to the common cold, allergies, and hay fever.
uses.recreational: Multiple public health agencies (most notably within the United States) have warned against the recreational use of propylhexedrine and advised for its use only as directed by a product's labeling; nonetheless it has been reported, through the literature as early as 1959, that propylhexedrine products have been used for recreational purposes.

sideEffects.text: When used as an inhaler, the most common adverse effects warned about for propylhexedrine are temporary discomfort (e.g., stinging or burning sensations) or rebound congestion. The sharing of propylhexedrine inhalers may spread infection. The occurrence of these adverse effects is uncommon as propylhexedrine is generally recognized as safe and effective.

summaryZh: 丙己君，又名六氫脫氧麻黃鹼、環己丙甲胺，是一種擬交感神經胺類藥物，主要用作局部減充血劑。其主要適應症為緩解感冒、過敏及過敏性鼻炎引起的鼻塞症狀。
summaryZhHans: 丙己君，又名六氢脱氧麻黄碱、环己丙甲胺，是一种拟交感神经胺类药物，主要用作局部减充血剂。其主要适应症为缓解感冒、过敏及过敏性鼻炎引起的鼻塞症状。

fact.en: Propylhexedrine is methamphetamine with its flat benzene ring replaced by a puckered cyclohexane ring. It replaced amphetamine in Benzedrex nasal inhalers in 1949, after the original amphetamine inhalers were widely misused.
fact.zh: 丙己君就是把甲基安非他命的平面苯環換成皺褶狀的環己烷環。1949 年，由於原本含安非他命的吸入器遭到廣泛濫用，Benzedrex 鼻用吸入器改用丙己君取代安非他命。
fact.zhHans: 丙己君就是把甲基安非他命的平面苯环换成皱褶状的环己烷环。1949 年，由于原本含安非他命的吸入器遭到广泛滥用，Benzedrex 鼻用吸入器改用丙己君取代安非他命。
